prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1133; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim file purposes. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Houston?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. I had just passed the crosswalk when a car coming from my right ran the red and struck the driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I noticed it coming fast and tried to brake, but there wasn't time to avoid it.

Q: Were you able to get out of your car afterward?

A: Yes, but I felt stiff right away. My neck snapped forward and then back, and I had a headache within an hour.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that evening. They checked my neck and back, took some X-rays, and told me it looked like whiplash. They gave me a neck brace and some medication for the pain.

Q: Have you had any follow-up care since then?

A: I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week. The neck pain is still there, especially when I turn my head or sit at a desk for long periods.

Q: Did you have any pain or stiffness in your neck or back before this accident?

A: No, not that I can recall. I was active and didn't have any ongoing problems.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I'm still missing work some days because of the pain, and I'd like the claim to reflect that. Thank you for your time.

Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with next steps.
